title: France's new head coach Zidane unveils team line-up for Nations League matches
summary: France's newly appointed head coach of its national men's football team Zinedine Zidane unveiled his first line-up Friday, featuring five new players and excluding former squad members Aurélien Tchouaméni and Marcus Thuram. Star forward Kylian Mbappé has again been named captain. Watch the video replay of our live coverage of the announcement.
